data.context_preview:
For a CIP pump mechanical seal kit purchase, record the pump/equipment identifier, location, observed need or failure, timing, operating and safety impact, and existing temporary actions. The Equipment Team must verify the technical need, seal-kit specification, compatibility, operating constraints, alternative options, and any unresolved technical inputs before handoff. The Purchasing Team then reviews master data, inventory, reservations, inbound supply, supply conditions, and purchase-request status; supplier confirmation, purchase execution, budget allocation, and ordering are outside this review SOP. Manufacturing Planning reviews production plans, material readiness, timing, and line/operational impact. All three teams' evidence and unresolved items must be accumulated before final human review. An authorized person makes the final decision on formal submission, approval, budget allocation, supplier confirmation, external communication, system entry, or purchase order; the SOP does not itself authorize or execute those actions.

SOP sources: SOP-01; SOP-02; SOP-03; SOP-04
